# `comptime-parameter-order`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a `comptime` parameter following a runtime parameter.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Comptime parameters configure a function; placing configuration first groups the
call site's constant part and matches common standard-library APIs.

## When it fires

External signatures are exempt, and so are parameters that cannot move: a
first receiver parameter (`self`, or typed as `Self`, `@This()` or an alias of
it, the enclosing container or `anyopaque`), and a comptime parameter whose
type names an earlier runtime parameter, as `comptime lessThan: fn
(@TypeOf(context), T, T) bool` does. A `T: type` parameter counts as comptime.
The rule reports only ordering and does not rearrange parameters or call
sites.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn fill(len: usize, comptime T: type) [4]T {
    _ = len;
    return undefined;
}
```
